### 1.1 Purpose

This standard defines mandatory requirements for configuring Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) and multi-tenant access controls in Lenses.io to ensure secure, auditable access to Kafka clusters and topics based on principle of least privilege, as specified in [ADR-IFR-008](../../../decisions/infrastructure/ADR-IFR-008-kafka-management-platform-selection.md).

### 1.2 Scope

**In Scope**:
- Lenses.io RBAC role definition and assignment
- Multi-tenant access controls for MSK clusters and topics
- Service account management for applications and CI/CD
- Permission inheritance and group-based access
- Data access policies for PHI/PII topics
- Audit logging of access control changes
- Access request and approval workflows

**Out of Scope**:
- SSO/IDP integration (see STD-INFRA-KMGMT-004)
- AWS IAM policies for MSK access (see STD-INFRA-INT-001)
- Application-level authentication (see application standards)
- Data masking configuration (see STD-INFRA-KMGMT-010)

#### REQ-LENS-003-001: Default Role Definitions

**Status**: Mandatory
**Rationale**: Standardize role definitions across organization per ADR-IFR-008

**Requirements**:
- Define **Platform Admin** role with full Lenses.io administrative access
- Define **Developer** role with read/write access to non-production clusters
- Define **Read-Only** role with view-only access to all clusters
- Define **Production Developer** role with restricted production access
- Define **Data Steward** role for schema and data governance
- Implement custom roles only with Architecture Review Board approval

**Implementation**:
```yaml
# Lenses.io Default Role Definitions
# Configure in Lenses UI → Admin → Roles or via Lenses API

roles:
  # 1. Platform Admin Role
  - name: "Platform-Admin"
    description: "Full administrative access to Lenses.io platform"
    type: "admin"

    permissions:
      # Cluster Management
      clusters:
        - action: ["VIEW", "CREATE", "EDIT", "DELETE"]
          resource: "*"  # All clusters

      # Connection Management
      connections:
        - action: ["VIEW", "CREATE", "EDIT", "DELETE"]
          resource: "*"

      # User & Role Management
      users:
        - action: ["VIEW", "CREATE", "EDIT", "DELETE", "ASSIGN_ROLES"]
          resource: "*"

      roles:
        - action: ["VIEW", "CREATE", "EDIT", "DELETE"]
          resource: "*"

      # RBAC Policy Management
      policies:
        - action: ["VIEW", "CREATE", "EDIT", "DELETE"]
          resource: "*"

      # Platform Configuration
      settings:
        - action: ["VIEW", "EDIT"]
          resource: ["platform", "license", "integrations", "monitoring"]

      # Audit Logs
      audit:
        - action: ["VIEW", "EXPORT"]
          resource: "*"

      # Data Access (All Topics)
      topics:
        - action: ["VIEW", "BROWSE", "QUERY", "PRODUCE", "CREATE", "EDIT", "DELETE"]
          resource: "*"

      # Consumer Groups
      consumer_groups:
        - action: ["VIEW", "EDIT", "DELETE"]
          resource: "*"

      # Schema Registry
      schemas:
        - action: ["VIEW", "CREATE", "EDIT", "DELETE", "EVOLVE"]
          resource: "*"

      # LSQL Queries
      lsql:
        - action: ["EXECUTE", "CREATE", "EDIT", "DELETE"]
          resource: "*"
          limits:
            max_concurrent_queries: 10
            max_memory_mb: 4096
            max_execution_time_sec: 300

      # Alerts & Monitoring
      alerts:
        - action: ["VIEW", "CREATE", "EDIT", "DELETE"]
          resource: "*"

    assignment_criteria:
      max_users: 5
      requires_mfa: true
      approval_required: true
      approver: "Director of Platform Engineering"
      review_frequency: "quarterly"
      allowed_groups: ["platform-engineering-admins"]

  # 2. Developer Role
  - name: "Developer"
    description: "Read/write access to non-production clusters"
    type: "standard"

    permissions:
      # Cluster Access (Non-Production Only)
      clusters:
        - action: ["VIEW"]
          resource:
            - "dev-*"
            - "test-*"
            - "staging-*"

      # Topic Access (Scoped by Business Unit)
      topics:
        - action: ["VIEW", "BROWSE", "QUERY"]
          resource: "{business-unit}.*"  # e.g., claims.*, enrollment.*
          data_masking: "enforced"  # All PHI/PII masked

        - action: ["CREATE"]
          resource: "{business-unit}.{application}.*"
          conditions:
            max_partitions: 10
            auto_approve: true

        - action: ["EDIT"]
          resource: "{business-unit}.{application}.*"
          conditions:
            allowed_changes: ["retention", "segment.bytes"]
            approval_required: false

        - action: ["PRODUCE"]
          resource: "{business-unit}.{application}.test.*"
          conditions:
            rate_limit_mb_per_sec: 10

      # Consumer Groups (Own Application Only)
      consumer_groups:
        - action: ["VIEW", "EDIT"]
          resource: "{business-unit}-{application}-*"

      # Schema Registry (Read-Only)
      schemas:
        - action: ["VIEW"]
          resource: "{business-unit}.*"

      # LSQL Queries (With Limits)
      lsql:
        - action: ["EXECUTE"]
          resource: "*"
          limits:
            max_concurrent_queries: 3
            max_memory_mb: 1024
            max_execution_time_sec: 60
            data_masking: "enforced"

      # No Production Access (Must Request via Workflow)
      production_access:
        default: "denied"
        request_workflow: "enabled"

    assignment_criteria:
      approval_required: true
      approver: "Team Lead"
      auto_assign_via_sso: true
      sso_groups: ["lenses-developers-{business-unit}"]
      review_frequency: "quarterly"
      inactivity_expiration_days: 90

  # 3. Production Developer Role
  - name: "Production-Developer"
    description: "Read-only access to production with data masking"
    type: "standard"

    permissions:
      # Cluster Access (Production Read-Only)
      clusters:
        - action: ["VIEW"]
          resource: "prod-*"

      # Topic Access (Read-Only with Data Masking)
      topics:
        - action: ["VIEW", "BROWSE"]
          resource: "*"
          data_masking: "enforced"

        - action: ["QUERY"]
          resource: "*"
          conditions:
            read_only: true
            data_masking: "enforced"
            max_results: 1000

      # Consumer Groups (View-Only)
      consumer_groups:
        - action: ["VIEW"]
          resource: "*"

      # Schema Registry (Read-Only)
      schemas:
        - action: ["VIEW"]
          resource: "*"

      # LSQL Queries (Strict Read-Only)
      lsql:
        - action: ["EXECUTE"]
          resource: "SELECT_ONLY"  # No INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE
          limits:
            max_concurrent_queries: 2
            max_memory_mb: 512
            max_execution_time_sec: 30
            data_masking: "enforced"

      # Metrics & Monitoring (Full Access)
      metrics:
        - action: ["VIEW"]
          resource: "*"

      dashboards:
        - action: ["VIEW"]
          resource: "*"

    assignment_criteria:
      approval_required: true
      approver: "Manager"
      requires_justification: true
      max_access_duration_days: 30  # Temporary access
      auto_expire: true
      review_frequency: "monthly"
      allowed_levels: ["L3", "L4", "L5"]  # Senior developers and above

  # 4. Read-Only Role
  - name: "Read-Only"
    description: "View-only access to all clusters for observability"
    type: "viewer"

    permissions:
      # Cluster View
      clusters:
        - action: ["VIEW"]
          resource: "*"

      # Topic View (No Data Browsing)
      topics:
        - action: ["VIEW"]
          resource: "*"

      # Consumer Groups View
      consumer_groups:
        - action: ["VIEW"]
          resource: "*"

      # Schema Registry View
      schemas:
        - action: ["VIEW"]
          resource: "*"

      # Metrics & Dashboards
      metrics:
        - action: ["VIEW"]
          resource: "*"

      dashboards:
        - action: ["VIEW"]
          resource: "*"

      # No Data Access
      data_browsing: "denied"
      lsql: "denied"
      topic_produce: "denied"

    assignment_criteria:
      approval_required: false  # Auto-approve
      auto_assign_new_users: true  # Default role
      review_frequency: "annually"
      allowed_groups: ["lenses-read-only", "product-managers", "qa-team", "auditors"]

  # 5. Data Steward Role
  - name: "Data-Steward"
    description: "Schema governance and data quality management"
    type: "governance"

    permissions:
      # Schema Registry (Full Management)
      schemas:
        - action: ["VIEW", "CREATE", "EDIT", "EVOLVE", "DELETE"]
          resource: "*"
        - action: ["SET_COMPATIBILITY"]
          resource: "*"

      # Topic View (For Schema Validation)
      topics:
        - action: ["VIEW", "BROWSE"]
          resource: "*"
          data_masking: "enforced"

      # Data Quality Monitoring
      data_quality:
        - action: ["VIEW", "CREATE", "EDIT"]
          resource: "*"

      # Data Lineage
      lineage:
        - action: ["VIEW"]
          resource: "*"

      # Data Classification
      classification:
        - action: ["VIEW", "EDIT"]
          resource: "*"

      # Alerts (Schema-Related)
      alerts:
        - action: ["VIEW", "CREATE", "EDIT", "DELETE"]
          resource: "schema.*"

    assignment_criteria:
      approval_required: true
      approver: "Chief Data Officer"
      review_frequency: "quarterly"
      allowed_groups: ["data-governance-team"]

# Role Assignment Matrix
role_assignment_matrix:
  business_units:
    claims:
      developers: ["Developer"]
      senior_developers: ["Production-Developer"]
      team_leads: ["Developer", "Production-Developer"]
      data_team: ["Data-Steward", "Production-Developer"]

    enrollment:
      developers: ["Developer"]
      senior_developers: ["Production-Developer"]
      team_leads: ["Developer", "Production-Developer"]
      data_team: ["Data-Steward", "Production-Developer"]

    platform:
      engineers: ["Platform-Admin"]

  stakeholders:
    product_managers: ["Read-Only"]
    qa_team: ["Read-Only", "Developer"]  # Read-Only + Developer for test environments
    auditors: ["Read-Only"]
    compliance_team: ["Read-Only", "Data-Steward"]

# Custom Role Approval Process
custom_roles:
  creation_process:
    - step: "Submit request to Architecture Review Board (ARB)"
    - step: "ARB reviews business justification and security implications"
    - step: "Security team validates permissions and data access"
    - step: "CISO approval required for roles with PHI/PII access"
    - step: "Platform Admin creates role in Lenses.io"
    - step: "Document custom role in standards repository"

  approval_criteria:
    - "Custom role not achievable with existing roles"
    - "Clear business need and justification"
    - "Follows principle of least privilege"
    - "No overlap with existing roles"
    - "Documented assignment and review process"
```

#### REQ-LENS-003-002: Platform Admin Role

**Status**: Mandatory
**Rationale**: Full control for platform engineering team

**Permissions**:
- Manage all Kafka cluster connections
- Create/modify/delete users and roles
- Configure platform settings and integrations
- Access all topics and consumer groups
- Modify RBAC policies and data access controls
- View audit logs and compliance reports
- Manage Lenses.io license and configuration

**Assignment Criteria**:
- Limit to Platform Engineering team members only
- Require MFA enforcement via SSO
- Maximum 5 platform admin users
- Quarterly access review mandatory

**Implementation**:
```yaml
# Platform Admin Role Configuration
# Full administrative access to Lenses.io platform

role:
  name: "Platform-Admin"
  type: "admin"
  description: "Complete platform administration including user management, cluster configuration, and system settings"

  # Full Permission Set
  permissions:
    # Administrative Permissions
    administration:
      - manage_users: true
      - manage_roles: true
      - manage_policies: true
      - manage_service_accounts: true
      - manage_api_keys: true
      - configure_integrations: true
      - manage_license: true
      - view_audit_logs: true
      - export_audit_logs: true

    # Cluster Management
    clusters:
      - view_all: true
      - create_cluster: true
      - edit_cluster: true
      - delete_cluster: true
      - manage_connections: true

    # Data Access (Full)
    data:
      - view_topics: "*"
      - browse_topics: "*"
      - query_topics: "*"
      - produce_messages: "*"
      - create_topics: true
      - edit_topics: true
      - delete_topics: true
      - bypass_data_masking: true  # For troubleshooting only

    # Consumer Group Management
    consumer_groups:
      - view_all: true
      - edit_offsets: true
      - delete_groups: true

    # Schema Registry
    schemas:
      - view_schemas: true
      - create_schemas: true
      - evolve_schemas: true
      - delete_schemas: true
      - set_compatibility: true

    # Monitoring & Alerting
    monitoring:
      - view_metrics: true
      - create_alerts: true
      - edit_alerts: true
      - delete_alerts: true
      - configure_dashboards: true

    # LSQL Queries (Unlimited)
    lsql:
      - execute_queries: true
      - create_processors: true
      - edit_processors: true
      - delete_processors: true
      - no_resource_limits: true

# Assignment Criteria and Controls
assignment:
  # Strict Limitations
  max_users: 5
  current_users: 3  # Track actual assignments

  # Required Security Controls
  security_requirements:
    mfa_required: true
    mfa_method: "Hardware Token or Authenticator App"
    ip_allowlist_required: true
    allowed_ip_ranges:
      - "10.0.0.0/8"  # Corporate network
      - "VPN gateway IPs"
    session_timeout_minutes: 30
    concurrent_sessions_max: 1

  # Approval Process
  approval:
    required: true
    approver_role: "Director of Platform Engineering"
    approver_backup: "VP of Engineering"
    requires_written_justification: true
    approval_sla_hours: 24

  # Eligible Personnel
  eligibility:
    department: "Platform Engineering"
    minimum_level: "Senior Engineer (L4)"
    minimum_tenure_months: 6
    background_check_required: true
    training_required:
      - "Lenses.io Platform Administration"
      - "Security & Compliance Fundamentals"
      - "HIPAA Data Handling"

  # Assignment Groups
  sso_groups:
    - "lenses-platform-admins"

  # Temporary Access
  temporary_access:
    max_duration_days: 90
    requires_renewal: true
    renewal_review: "mandatory"

# Access Review Process
access_review:
  frequency: "quarterly"
  review_month: ["January", "April", "July", "October"]

  review_process:
    - step: "Platform sends automated notification 7 days before review"
    - step: "Director of Platform Engineering reviews all Platform Admin assignments"
    - step: "Verify each user still requires Platform Admin access"
    - step: "Check for any access violations or anomalies"
    - step: "Document review completion in audit log"
    - step: "Revoke access if review not completed within 30 days"

  review_criteria:
    - "User is still employed in Platform Engineering team"
    - "User has logged in within past 90 days"
    - "No security incidents or policy violations"
    - "Role still required for current job responsibilities"
    - "User completed annual security training"

  auto_revocation:
    enabled: true
    triggers:
      - condition: "Review not completed within 30 days"
        action: "Revoke access immediately"
      - condition: "No login activity for 60 days"
        action: "Disable account, notify manager"
      - condition: "Terminated employment"
        action: "Immediate revocation via HR system integration"
      - condition: "Department transfer"
        action: "Flag for review within 7 days"

# Audit Logging
audit_logging:
  events_to_log:
    - "Platform Admin role assignment"
    - "Platform Admin role revocation"
    - "Permission changes to Platform Admin role"
    - "Platform Admin login/logout"
    - "Administrative actions performed (user creation, role changes, etc.)"
    - "Data masking bypass usage"
    - "Cluster configuration changes"
    - "Service account API key creation"

  log_retention:
    lenses_internal: "90 days"
    aws_s3_archive: "7 years"  # HIPAA compliance

  log_format:
    timestamp: "ISO8601"
    user_identity: "email + SSO ID"
    action: "detailed description"
    resource: "affected resource"
    result: "success | failure"
    ip_address: "source IP"
    session_id: "unique session identifier"

# Monitoring & Alerts
monitoring:
  alerts:
    - name: "Excessive Platform Admin Logins"
      condition: "Platform Admin logins > 50 per hour"
      severity: "HIGH"
      notify: ["SOC", "Platform Engineering Lead"]

    - name: "Platform Admin Access from Unknown IP"
      condition: "Login from IP not in allowlist"
      severity: "CRITICAL"
      notify: ["SOC", "CISO", "Platform Engineering Director"]
      action: "Block session immediately"

    - name: "Data Masking Bypass Usage"
      condition: "Platform Admin bypasses data masking on PHI topics"
      severity: "HIGH"
      notify: ["Security Team", "Compliance Officer"]

    - name: "Platform Admin Count Exceeds Limit"
      condition: "Active Platform Admins > 5"
      severity: "MEDIUM"
      notify: ["Platform Engineering Director"]

  metrics:
    - "Count of active Platform Admin users"
    - "Platform Admin login frequency per user"
    - "Administrative actions per Platform Admin per day"
    - "Failed login attempts"
    - "Data masking bypass count"
```

```bash
# Platform Admin Assignment Script
# Execute by current Platform Admin only

#!/bin/bash
set -e

# Configuration
LENSES_URL="https://lenses.company.com"
LENSES_API_TOKEN="<platform-admin-token>"
NEW_USER_EMAIL="$1"
APPROVAL_TICKET="$2"  # ServiceNow or JIRA ticket
JUSTIFICATION="$3"

echo "================================================="
echo "Platform Admin Role Assignment"
echo "================================================="
echo "User: ${NEW_USER_EMAIL}"
echo "Approval Ticket: ${APPROVAL_TICKET}"
echo "Justification: ${JUSTIFICATION}"
echo ""

# Step 1: Verify approval ticket
echo "[1/6] Verifying approval ticket..."
APPROVAL_STATUS=$(curl -s -X GET "https://servicenow.company.com/api/now/table/sc_request/${APPROVAL_TICKET}" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${SN_TOKEN}" | jq -r '.result.approval')

if [ "${APPROVAL_STATUS}" != "approved" ]; then
  echo "✗ Approval ticket not approved. Current status: ${APPROVAL_STATUS}"
  exit 1
fi
echo "✓ Approval verified"

# Step 2: Check current Platform Admin count
echo "[2/6] Checking Platform Admin count..."
CURRENT_COUNT=$(curl -s -X GET "${LENSES_URL}/api/v1/users" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${LENSES_API_TOKEN}" | \
  jq '[.[] | select(.roles[] | contains("Platform-Admin"))] | length')

if [ ${CURRENT_COUNT} -ge 5 ]; then
  echo "✗ Platform Admin limit reached (${CURRENT_COUNT}/5). Cannot assign new admin."
  exit 1
fi
echo "✓ Current count: ${CURRENT_COUNT}/5"

# Step 3: Verify user exists
echo "[3/6] Verifying user exists..."
USER_EXISTS=$(curl -s -X GET "${LENSES_URL}/api/v1/users/${NEW_USER_EMAIL}" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${LENSES_API_TOKEN}" | jq -r '.email')

if [ "${USER_EXISTS}" != "${NEW_USER_EMAIL}" ]; then
  echo "✗ User not found: ${NEW_USER_EMAIL}"
  exit 1
fi
echo "✓ User found"

# Step 4: Verify MFA enabled
echo "[4/6] Verifying MFA status..."
MFA_STATUS=$(curl -s -X GET "${LENSES_URL}/api/v1/users/${NEW_USER_EMAIL}" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${LENSES_API_TOKEN}" | jq -r '.mfa_enabled')

if [ "${MFA_STATUS}" != "true" ]; then
  echo "✗ MFA not enabled for user. Platform Admin requires MFA."
  exit 1
fi
echo "✓ MFA enabled"

# Step 5: Assign Platform Admin role
echo "[5/6] Assigning Platform-Admin role..."
curl -s -X POST "${LENSES_URL}/api/v1/users/${NEW_USER_EMAIL}/roles" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${LENSES_API_TOKEN}" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "roles": ["Platform-Admin"],
    "justification": "'"${JUSTIFICATION}"'",
    "approval_ticket": "'"${APPROVAL_TICKET}"'"
  }'

echo "✓ Role assigned"

# Step 6: Send notification
echo "[6/6] Sending notifications..."

# Notify user
cat > email-user.txt << EOF
Subject: Platform Admin Access Granted - Lenses.io

Dear ${NEW_USER_EMAIL},

You have been granted Platform Admin access to Lenses.io.

With great power comes great responsibility. Please review:
- Platform Admin Runbook: https://wiki.company.com/lenses/platform-admin
- Security Guidelines: https://wiki.company.com/security/admin-guidelines
- Audit Log Policy: https://wiki.company.com/compliance/audit-logs

Your access will be reviewed quarterly. Next review: [DATE].

Approval Ticket: ${APPROVAL_TICKET}
Granted By: $(whoami)
Timestamp: $(date -u +"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ")

-- Lenses.io Platform Team
EOF

# Notify director
cat > email-director.txt << EOF
Subject: Platform Admin Assigned - ${NEW_USER_EMAIL}

A new Platform Admin has been assigned:

User: ${NEW_USER_EMAIL}
Approval: ${APPROVAL_TICKET}
Justification: ${JUSTIFICATION}
Current Admin Count: $((CURRENT_COUNT + 1))/5
Granted By: $(whoami)

Next quarterly review: [DATE]

-- Automated Notification
EOF

# Send emails (replace with actual email service)
mail -s "Platform Admin Access Granted" ${NEW_USER_EMAIL} < email-user.txt
mail -s "Platform Admin Assigned" director@company.com < email-director.txt

echo "✓ Notifications sent"

echo ""
echo "================================================="
echo "Platform Admin role successfully assigned to ${NEW_USER_EMAIL}"
echo "Current Platform Admin count: $((CURRENT_COUNT + 1))/5"
echo "================================================="
```

#### REQ-LENS-003-003: Developer Role

**Status**: Mandatory
**Rationale**: Application development team access to non-production environments

**Permissions**:
- Read/write access to dev, test, staging clusters
- Create topics with ≤10 partitions (auto-approved)
- Browse and query topic data (with data masking)
- Monitor consumer groups for own applications
- View schema registry (read-only)
- Execute LSQL queries (with resource limits)
- No access to production topics (except read-only via approval)

**Assignment Criteria**:
- Assigned to application developers by team lead
- Scoped to specific business unit/application
- Automated provisioning via SSO group membership
- Access expires after 90 days of inactivity

**Implementation**:
```yaml
# Developer Role Configuration
# Read/write access to non-production environments with data masking

role:
  name: "Developer"
  type: "standard"
  description: "Application development team access to dev, test, and staging environments"

  # Developer Permission Set
  permissions:
    # Cluster Access (Non-Production Only)
    clusters:
      allowed:
        - pattern: "dev-*"
          environment: "development"
        - pattern: "test-*"
          environment: "test"
        - pattern: "staging-*"
          environment: "staging"

      denied:
        - pattern: "prod-*"
          reason: "Production access requires Production-Developer role"

    # Topic Access (Scoped by Business Unit)
    topics:
      # View/Browse/Query Access
      read:
        resource: "{business-unit}.*"
        data_masking: "enforced"  # All PHI/PII data masked
        conditions:
          - "User's business unit matches topic business unit"
          - "Topic is in allowed environment (dev/test/staging)"

      # Topic Creation (Limited)
      create:
        resource: "{business-unit}.{application}.*"
        auto_approve_conditions:

          max_replication_factor: 3
          retention_ms_max: 604800000  # 7 days
          segment_bytes_max: 1073741824  # 1 GB

          max_messages_per_sec: 1000

        resource: "{business-unit}-{application}-*"
        actions: ["VIEW", "DESCRIBE"]

      write:
        resource: "{business-unit}-{application}-*"
        actions: ["EDIT_OFFSET", "RESET_OFFSET"]
        conditions:
          - "Consumer group created by user's application"
          - "Non-production environment only"

      naming_enforcement:
        pattern: "^{business-unit}-{application}-[a-z0-9-]+$"
        examples:
          - "claims-adjudication-processor"
          - "enrollment-member-consumer"

    # Schema Registry (Read-Only)
    schemas:
      read:
        resource: "{business-unit}.*"
        actions: ["VIEW", "GET_SCHEMA", "LIST_VERSIONS"]

      create:
        denied: true
        reason: "Schema creation requires Data Steward approval"

    # LSQL Queries (With Resource Limits)
    lsql:
      execute:
        allowed: true
        query_types: ["SELECT", "CREATE_STREAM", "CREATE_TABLE"]

      resource_limits:
        max_concurrent_queries: 3
        max_memory_mb: 1024
        max_execution_time_sec: 60
        max_result_rows: 10000

      data_masking:
        enforced: true
        bypass_allowed: false

      monitoring:
        track_query_performance: true
        alert_on_long_running_queries: true
        threshold_sec: 45

    # Dashboards & Monitoring

      dashboards:
        - "Application-specific dashboards"
        - "Environment-specific dashboards (dev/test/staging)"

      metrics:
        view: ["throughput", "lag", "errors", "latency"]
        scope: "{business-unit}.{application}.*"

    # No Production Access (Default)
    production:
      default_access: "denied"
      request_mechanism: "access_request_workflow"
      max_request_duration_days: 7

# Environment Scoping
environment_scoping:
  development:
    clusters:
      - "dev-claims-msk-us-east-1"
      - "dev-enrollment-msk-us-east-1"
```

#### REQ-LENS-003-004: Production Developer Role

**Status**: Mandatory
**Rationale**: Controlled production access for senior developers

**Permissions**:
- Read-only access to production topics (with data masking)
- View consumer lag and broker metrics
- Execute read-only LSQL queries (strict resource limits)
- No topic creation or configuration changes
- No producer/consumer group management
- Request elevated access via approval workflow

**Assignment Criteria**:
- Requires manager approval
- Limited to senior developers (L3+) and above
- Temporary access grants (30-day max) for troubleshooting
- All access logged and audited
- Production access review every 30 days

```python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Production Developer Access Request Script
Handles temporary production access requests with approval workflow
"""

import requests
import json
import sys
from datetime import datetime, timedelta

# Configuration
LENSES_URL = "https://lenses.company.com"
LENSES_API_TOKEN = "<api-token>"
SERVICENOW_URL = "https://servicenow.company.com"
SN_API_TOKEN = "<sn-token>"

def request_production_access(user_email, justification, duration_days=7, incident_ticket=None):
    """
    Submit production access request
    """
    print("========================================")
    print("Production Developer Access Request")
    print("========================================")
    print(f"User: {user_email}")
    print(f"Duration: {duration_days} days")
    print(f"Justification: {justification}")
    if incident_ticket:
        print(f"Incident: {incident_ticket}")
    print("")

    # Step 1: Verify user eligibility
    print("[1/5] Verifying user eligibility...")
    user_response = requests.get(
        f"{LENSES_URL}/api/v1/users/{user_email}",
        headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {LENSES_API_TOKEN}"}
    )

    if user_response.status_code != 200:
        print(f"✗ User not found: {user_email}")
        return False

    user_data = user_response.json()

    # Check level requirement (L3+)
    user_level = user_data.get("level", "")
    if not user_level.startswith(("L3", "L4", "L5", "L6")):
        print(f"✗ User must be L3+ (current: {user_level})")
        return False

    # Check training completion
    required_training = [
        "Production Data Access & Security",
        "HIPAA Compliance for Developers"
    ]

    completed_training = user_data.get("training", [])
    for training in required_training:
        if training not in completed_training:
            print(f"✗ Missing required training: {training}")
            return False

    print("✓ User eligible")

    # Step 2: Validate incident ticket (if provided)
    fast_track = False
    if incident_ticket:
        print("[2/5] Validating incident ticket...")
        incident_response = requests.get(
            f"{SERVICENOW_URL}/api/now/table/incident/{incident_ticket}",
            headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {SN_API_TOKEN}"}
        )

        if incident_response.status_code == 200:
            incident = incident_response.json()["result"]
            severity = incident.get("severity")
            state = incident.get("state")

            if severity in ["1", "2"] and state == "In Progress":
                print(f"✓ Valid Severity {severity} incident - fast-track approval enabled")
                fast_track = True
                duration_days = 1  # Override to 24 hours for incidents
            else:
                print(f"✓ Incident validated (Severity {severity})")
        else:
            print("⚠ Warning: Could not validate incident ticket")
    else:
        print("[2/5] No incident ticket provided (normal approval flow)")

    # Step 3: Submit access request
    print("[3/5] Submitting access request...")

    expiration_date = datetime.now() + timedelta(days=duration_days)

    request_data = {
        "user_email": user_email,
        "role": "Production-Developer",
        "justification": justification,
        "duration_days": duration_days,
        "expiration_date": expiration_date.isoformat(),
        "incident_ticket": incident_ticket,
        "fast_track": fast_track,
        "requested_by": user_email,
        "requested_at": datetime.now().isoformat()
    }

    request_response = requests.post(
        f"{LENSES_URL}/api/v1/access-requests",
        headers={
            "Authorization": f"Bearer {LENSES_API_TOKEN}",
            "Content-Type": "application/json"
        },
        json=request_data
    )

    if request_response.status_code != 201:
        print(f"✗ Failed to submit request: {request_response.text}")
        return False

    request_id = request_response.json()["request_id"]
    print(f"✓ Request submitted (ID: {request_id})")

    # Step 4: Trigger approval workflow
    print("[4/5] Triggering approval workflow...")

    if fast_track:
        # Fast-track: Skip manager approval, go straight to Platform Admin
        print("  → Fast-track mode: Skipping manager approval")
        print("  → Notifying Platform Admin on-call for immediate approval")
    else:
        # Normal flow: Manager → Platform Admin
        print(f"  → Sending approval request to manager")
        print(f"  → SLA: Manager approval within 2 hours")
        print(f"  → Then Platform Admin approval within 1 hour")

    # Create ServiceNow approval ticket
    sn_ticket_data = {
        "short_description": f"Production Access Request - {user_email}",
        "description": f"""User: {user_email}
Role: Production-Developer
Duration: {duration_days} days
Expiration: {expiration_date.strftime('%Y-%m-%d')}
Justification: {justification}
Incident: {incident_ticket or 'N/A'}
Request ID: {request_id}
""",
        "category": "Access Request",
        "urgency": "2" if fast_track else "3",
        "requested_for": user_email
    }

    sn_response = requests.post(
        f"{SERVICENOW_URL}/api/now/table/sc_request",
        headers={
            "Authorization": f"Bearer {SN_API_TOKEN}",
            "Content-Type": "application/json"
        },
        json=sn_ticket_data
    )

    if sn_response.status_code == 201:
        sn_ticket_number = sn_response.json()["result"]["number"]
        print(f"✓ ServiceNow ticket created: {sn_ticket_number}")

    # Step 5: Send notifications
    print("[5/5] Sending notifications...")

    # Notify user
    print(f"  → Email sent to {user_email}")

    # Notify manager
    manager_email = user_data.get("manager_email")
    if manager_email:
        print(f"  → Approval request sent to manager: {manager_email}")

    # Notify Platform Admin
    print(f"  → Platform Admin team notified")

    if fast_track:
        print(f"  → Security team notified (fast-track access)")

    print("")
    print("========================================")
    print("Access request submitted successfully")
    print(f"Request ID: {request_id}")
    print(f"ServiceNow Ticket: {sn_ticket_number}")
    print(f"Status: Pending Approval")
    if fast_track:
        print("Fast-Track: Expect approval within 1 hour")
    else:
        print("Standard: Expect approval within 3 hours")
    print("========================================")

    return True

if __name__ == "__main__":
    if len(sys.argv) < 3:
        print("Usage: python request_prod_access.py <user_email> <justification> [duration_days] [incident_ticket]")
        sys.exit(1)

    user_email = sys.argv[1]
    justification = sys.argv[2]
    duration_days = int(sys.argv[3]) if len(sys.argv) > 3 else 7
    incident_ticket = sys.argv[4] if len(sys.argv) > 4 else None

    success = request_production_access(user_email, justification, duration_days, incident_ticket)
    sys.exit(0 if success else 1)
```

#### REQ-LENS-003-005: Read-Only Role

**Status**: Mandatory
**Rationale**: Observability access for stakeholders and auditors

**Permissions**:
- View-only access to all clusters and topics
- View broker and consumer group metrics
- Access dashboards and monitoring pages
- No topic browsing or LSQL query execution
- No configuration changes
- No export or data extraction capabilities

**Assignment Criteria**:
- Assigned to product managers, QA, auditors
- Default role for all new users
- No approval required
- Access review annually

**Implementation**:
```yaml
# Read-Only Role Configuration
# View-only observability access for stakeholders and auditors

role:
  name: "Read-Only"
  type: "default"
  description: "Default role for all users - view-only access to cluster metadata and metrics"

  # View-Only Permissions
  permissions:
    # Cluster Access (All Clusters)
    clusters:
      allowed:
        - pattern: "*"
          access_type: "view_only"
          actions: ["VIEW", "LIST", "DESCRIBE"]

      denied:
        - action: "CREATE"
        - action: "EDIT"
        - action: "DELETE"
        - action: "CONFIGURE"

    # Topic Metadata (View-Only, No Data Access)
    topics:
      metadata:
        resource: "*"
        actions: ["VIEW", "LIST", "DESCRIBE"]
        allowed_info:
          - "Topic name"
          - "Partition count"
          - "Replication factor"
          - "Configuration settings"
          - "Size metrics (bytes, message count)"
          - "Throughput metrics (MB/sec, messages/sec)"

      data_access:
        browse: false
        query: false
        produce: false
        reason: "Read-Only role has no data access - use Developer or Production-Developer for data access"

    # Consumer Group Metadata (View-Only)
    consumer_groups:
      metadata:
        resource: "*"
        actions: ["VIEW", "LIST", "DESCRIBE"]
        allowed_info:
          - "Consumer group name"
          - "State (active, inactive)"
          - "Member count"
          - "Lag metrics (total lag, per-partition lag)"
          - "Consumer assignments"

      management:
        edit_offset: false
        reset_offset: false
        delete_group: false

    # Schema Registry (View-Only)
    schemas:
      metadata:
        resource: "*"
        actions: ["VIEW", "LIST", "GET_SCHEMA"]
        allowed_info:
          - "Schema subject names"
          - "Schema versions"
          - "Schema compatibility settings"
          - "Schema definitions"

      management:
        create: false
        evolve: false
        delete: false
        set_compatibility: false

    # Kafka Connect (View-Only)
    connectors:
      metadata:
        resource: "*"
        actions: ["VIEW", "LIST", "STATUS"]
        allowed_info:
          - "Connector names"
          - "Connector status"
          - "Task status"
          - "Configuration (view only)"

      management:
        create: false
        edit: false
        delete: false
        restart: false
        pause_resume: false

    # LSQL Queries (Prohibited)
    lsql:
      execute: false
      reason: "Read-Only role cannot execute LSQL queries - use Developer role for query access"

    # Monitoring & Metrics (Full View Access)
    monitoring:
      metrics:
        view: "all"
        scope: "*"
        allowed_metrics:
          # Cluster Metrics
          - "Broker CPU and memory usage"
          - "Disk utilization"
          - "Network throughput"
          - "Active connections"
          - "Partition count"
          - "Under-replicated partitions"
          - "Offline partitions"

          # Topic Metrics
          - "Message throughput (messages/sec, MB/sec)"
          - "Topic size (bytes, message count)"
          - "Partition distribution"
          - "Retention time"

          # Consumer Metrics
          - "Consumer lag (total and per-partition)"
          - "Consumer throughput"
          - "Rebalance events"
          - "Consumer errors"

          # Producer Metrics
          - "Producer throughput"
          - "Producer errors"
          - "Message batch sizes"

      dashboards:
        view: "all"
        create: false
        edit: false
        delete: false

        available_dashboards:
          - "Cluster Health Overview"
          - "Topic Performance"
          - "Consumer Lag Monitoring"
          - "Broker Performance"
          - "Application-Specific Dashboards"
          - "SLA Compliance Dashboards"

      alerts:
        view: true
        create: false
        edit: false
        delete: false
        acknowledge: false

    # Audit Logs (View-Only)
    audit_logs:
      view: true
      scope: "own_actions"  # Can only see own audit logs
      export: false

    # Administration (No Access)
    administration:
      users: false
      roles: false
      policies: false
      service_accounts: false
      api_keys: false
      integrations: false
      license: false

# Metric Access Details
metric_access:
  categories:
    cluster_health:
      - metric: "kafka.server:type=BrokerTopicMetrics,name=MessagesInPerSec"
        description: "Broker message throughput"
      - metric: "kafka.server:type=BrokerTopicMetrics,name=BytesInPerSec"
        description: "Broker bytes received per second"
      - metric: "kafka.server:type=BrokerTopicMetrics,name=BytesOutPerSec"
        description: "Broker bytes sent per second"
      - metric: "kafka.controller:type=KafkaController,name=OfflinePartitionsCount"
        description: "Offline partition count"
      - metric: "kafka.server:type=ReplicaManager,name=UnderReplicatedPartitions"
        description: "Under-replicated partition count"

    consumer_lag:
      - metric: "kafka.consumer:type=consumer-fetch-manager-metrics,partition={partition},topic={topic},client-id={client-id}"
        description: "Consumer lag per partition"
      - metric: "kafka_consumergroup_lag"
        description: "Total consumer group lag"

    topic_metrics:
      - metric: "kafka.log:type=Log,name=Size,topic={topic},partition={partition}"
        description: "Topic size in bytes"
      - metric: "kafka.server:type=BrokerTopicMetrics,name=TotalProduceRequestsPerSec,topic={topic}"
        description: "Produce requests per second per topic"

    system_resources:
      - metric: "kafka.server:type=KafkaServer,name=ProcessCpuLoad"
        description: "Broker CPU usage"
      - metric: "kafka.server:type=KafkaServer,name=ProcessMemoryUsed"
        description: "Broker memory usage"
      - metric: "kafka.log:type=LogManager,name=LogDirectoryOffline"
        description: "Offline log directories"

  refresh_rate:
    real_time: "10 seconds"
    historical: "1 minute intervals"

  retention:
    metrics: "90 days"
    dashboards: "indefinite"

# Dashboard Visibility
dashboard_visibility:
  default_dashboards:
    - name: "Cluster Overview"
      description: "High-level cluster health and performance"
      widgets:
        - "Broker status"
        - "Topic count"
        - "Total throughput"
        - "Offline/under-replicated partitions"
        - "Active consumer groups"

    - name: "Topic Performance"
      description: "Per-topic metrics and trends"
      widgets:
        - "Top topics by throughput"
        - "Top topics by size"
        - "Topic retention compliance"
        - "Partition distribution"

    - name: "Consumer Lag"
      description: "Consumer group lag monitoring"
      widgets:
        - "Consumer groups by total lag"
        - "Lag trends over time"
        - "Consumers at risk (high lag)"
        - "Consumer group status"

    - name: "SLA Compliance"
      description: "Service level agreement tracking"
      widgets:
        - "Message delivery latency (p95, p99)"
        - "Cluster availability percentage"
        - "Error rate"
        - "SLA violations"

  custom_dashboards:
    view_existing: true
    create_new: false
    edit_existing: false
    delete: false
    export: true  # Can export dashboard screenshots/PDFs

  dashboard_sharing:
    share_url: true
    embed_iframe: true
    schedule_reports: false  # Cannot schedule automated reports

# Assignment Criteria (Auto-Assign)
assignment:
  default_role: true  # Assigned to all new users by default

  auto_provisioning:
    enabled: true
    method: "automatic"
    trigger:
      - "User created in Lenses.io"
      - "User first login via SSO"

  approval:
    required: false  # No approval needed for Read-Only role
    auto_approve: true

  eligibility:
    minimum_requirements: "none"
    applies_to:
      - "All employees"
      - "Contractors"
      - "Auditors"
      - "External stakeholders (with corporate account)"

  sso_groups:
    - "lenses-users"  # All users in this group get Read-Only
    - "lenses-stakeholders"
    - "lenses-auditors"
    - "lenses-qa-team"

# Access Review (Annual)
access_review:
  frequency: "annual"

  review_process:
    - step: "Generate report of all Read-Only users"
      schedule: "January 1st each year"

    - step: "Validate SSO group memberships"
      automated: true

    - step: "Identify inactive users (no login in 12 months)"
      automated: true

    - step: "Remove inactive users"
      action: "Automatic removal"
      notification: "Email manager for confirmation"

  inactivity_threshold:
    warning_days: 335  # Warn 30 days before 12-month mark
    revocation_days: 365  # Remove after 12 months of inactivity

  exception_handling:
    auditors: "Retain indefinitely (require annual certification)"
    executives: "Retain indefinitely"
    contractors: "Remove 30 days after contract end date"

# Use Cases for Read-Only Role
use_cases:
  - persona: "Product Managers"
    need: "Monitor application metrics and consumer lag for product health"
    access: "Cluster overview, topic metrics, consumer lag dashboards"

  - persona: "QA Team"
    need: "Verify test data flow and validate integration tests"
    access: "Topic metadata, consumer group status, test environment metrics"

  - persona: "Auditors"
    need: "Review Kafka usage, compliance with data policies"
    access: "All cluster metadata, topic configurations, audit logs (own)"

  - persona: "Compliance Officers"
    need: "Monitor data access patterns, verify security controls"
    access: "Dashboards, alerts, schema registry metadata"

  - persona: "Business Analysts"
    need: "Understand data flow and system architecture"
    access: "Cluster topology, topic naming conventions, metrics"

  - persona: "Executives"
    need: "High-level platform health and usage statistics"
    access: "Executive dashboards, SLA compliance reports"

# Upgrade Path
upgrade_path:
  to_developer:
    justification: "Requires data access for development work"
    approval: "Team Lead"
    process: "Submit access request via Lenses.io or ServiceNow"

  to_production_developer:
    justification: "Requires production troubleshooting access"
    approval: "Manager + Platform Admin"
    process: "Submit access request with incident ticket"

  to_data_steward:
    justification: "Requires schema management capabilities"
    approval: "CDO (Chief Data Officer)"
    process: "Submit request through Architecture Review Board"

  to_platform_admin:
    justification: "Requires platform administration"
    approval: "Director of Platform Engineering + CISO"
    process: "Formal request with executive approval"
```

#### REQ-LENS-003-006: Multi-Tenant Access Controls

**Status**: Mandatory
**Rationale**: Isolate access between business units and applications

**Requirements**:
- Implement topic-level access controls using topic naming patterns
- Scope access by topic prefix: `{business-unit}.{application}.*`
- Enforce consumer group naming: `{business-unit}-{application}-{consumer-name}`
- Prevent cross-business-unit topic access without explicit grant
- Log all cross-business-unit access attempts

**Implementation**:
```yaml
# Multi-Tenant Access Control Policies
# Topic pattern-based isolation by business unit

multi_tenant_config:
  enforcement_level: "strict"
  isolation_model: "business_unit"

  # Business Unit Definitions
  business_units:
    - id: "claims"
      name: "Claims Processing"
      code: "CLM"
      topic_prefix: "claims"
      owner: "claims-team@company.com"

    - id: "enrollment"
      name: "Member Enrollment"
      code: "ENR"
      topic_prefix: "enrollment"
      owner: "enrollment-team@company.com"

    - id: "pharmacy"
      name: "Pharmacy Solutions"
      code: "PHR"
      topic_prefix: "pharmacy"
      owner: "pharmacy-team@company.com"

    - id: "provider"
      name: "Provider Solutions"
      code: "PRV"
      topic_prefix: "provider"
      owner: "provider-team@company.com"

    - id: "analytics"
      name: "Data Analytics"
      code: "ANL"
      topic_prefix: "analytics"
      owner: "analytics-team@company.com"

    - id: "platform"
      name: "Platform Services"
      code: "PLT"
      topic_prefix: "platform"
      owner: "platform-team@company.com"

# Topic Pattern-Based Access Rules
topic_access_rules:
  # Rule 1: Business Unit Scoping
  business_unit_scoping:
    enabled: true

    pattern_enforcement:
      # Each business unit only accesses their topics
      - business_unit: "claims"
        allowed_patterns:
          - "claims.*"
          - "platform.shared.*"  # Shared platform topics
        denied_patterns:
          - "enrollment.*"
          - "pharmacy.*"
          - "provider.*"
          - "analytics.*"

      - business_unit: "enrollment"
        allowed_patterns:
          - "enrollment.*"
          - "platform.shared.*"
        denied_patterns:
          - "claims.*"
          - "pharmacy.*"
          - "provider.*"
          - "analytics.*"

      - business_unit: "pharmacy"
        allowed_patterns:
          - "pharmacy.*"
          - "platform.shared.*"
        denied_patterns:
          - "claims.*"
          - "enrollment.*"
          - "provider.*"
          - "analytics.*"

      - business_unit: "provider"
        allowed_patterns:
          - "provider.*"
          - "platform.shared.*"
        denied_patterns:
          - "claims.*"
          - "enrollment.*"
          - "pharmacy.*"
          - "analytics.*"

      - business_unit: "analytics"
        allowed_patterns:
          - "analytics.*"
          - "*.*.analytics.*"  # Read analytics topics from all BUs
          - "platform.shared.*"
        read_only_patterns:
          - "claims.*"  # Can read, cannot produce
          - "enrollment.*"
          - "pharmacy.*"
          - "provider.*"

      - business_unit: "platform"
        allowed_patterns:
          - "platform.*"
          - "*"  # Platform team has full access
        restrictions:
          - "Require approval for production data access"
          - "Data masking enforced for non-Platform-Admin"

  # Rule 2: Topic Naming Convention Enforcement
  naming_convention:
    enabled: true

    pattern: "^{business-unit}\\.{application}\\.{entity}\\.{event-type}\\.v{version}$"

    examples:
      - "claims.adjudication.decision.approved.v1"
      - "enrollment.member.profile.updated.v2"
      - "pharmacy.prescription.order.created.v1"
      - "provider.network.contract.renewed.v1"
      - "analytics.reporting.dashboard.generated.v1"
      - "platform.shared.audit.logged.v1"

    validation:
      regex: "^[a-z]+\\.[a-z-]+\\.[a-z-]+\\.[a-z-]+\\.v[0-9]+$"
      max_length: 249  # Kafka topic name limit: 249 chars

      prohibited_patterns:
        - "test.*"  # Use proper BU prefix
        - "temp.*"  # No temporary topics
        - "*.prod.*"  # Don't embed environment in name

      reserved_prefixes:
        - "_internal."  # Kafka internal topics
        - "__consumer_offsets"  # Kafka system topics
        - "__transaction_state"

  # Rule 3: Environment-Based Isolation
  environment_isolation:
    enabled: true

    environments:
      development:
        cluster_prefix: "dev-"
        cross_bu_access: "allowed"  # Relaxed for testing
        data_masking: "enforced"

      test:
        cluster_prefix: "test-"
        cross_bu_access: "allowed_with_justification"
        data_masking: "enforced"

      staging:
        cluster_prefix: "staging-"
        cross_bu_access: "requires_approval"
        data_masking: "strictly_enforced"

      production:
        cluster_prefix: "prod-"
        cross_bu_access: "prohibited"  # No cross-BU access in prod
        data_masking: "strictly_enforced"
        exceptions:
          - business_unit: "analytics"
            reason: "Read-only access for reporting"
            approval: "CDO + BU owners"
          - business_unit: "platform"
            reason: "Operational support"
            approval: "Platform Admin"

# Business Unit Isolation
business_unit_isolation:
  # Logical Isolation via Access Control
  logical_separation:
    method: "rbac_policies"
    enforcement_point: "lenses_io"

    isolation_policies:
      # Isolate by SSO group membership
      - type: "sso_group_based"
        mapping:
          - sso_group: "lenses-developers-claims"
            business_unit: "claims"
            allowed_topic_patterns: ["claims.*", "platform.shared.*"]

          - sso_group: "lenses-developers-enrollment"
            business_unit: "enrollment"
            allowed_topic_patterns: ["enrollment.*", "platform.shared.*"]

          - sso_group: "lenses-developers-pharmacy"
            business_unit: "pharmacy"
            allowed_topic_patterns: ["pharmacy.*", "platform.shared.*"]

          - sso_group: "lenses-developers-provider"
            business_unit: "provider"
            allowed_topic_patterns: ["provider.*", "platform.shared.*"]

          - sso_group: "lenses-developers-analytics"
            business_unit: "analytics"
            allowed_topic_patterns: ["analytics.*", "*.*.analytics.*", "platform.shared.*"]
            read_only_patterns: ["claims.*", "enrollment.*", "pharmacy.*", "provider.*"]

      # Isolate by application
      - type: "application_based"
        mapping:
          - application: "claims-adjudication"
            allowed_topics:
              - "claims.adjudication.*"
              - "platform.shared.events.*"
            allowed_consumer_groups:
              - "claims-adjudication-*"

          - application: "enrollment-processor"
            allowed_topics:
              - "enrollment.member.*"
              - "enrollment.plan.*"
              - "platform.shared.events.*"
            allowed_consumer_groups:
              - "enrollment-processor-*"

  # Physical Isolation (Optional)
  physical_separation:
    enabled: false  # Not using dedicated clusters per BU
    reason: "Cost optimization - using logical isolation via ACLs"

    future_consideration:
      threshold: "If any BU exceeds 100 topics or 1 TB/day throughput"
      approach: "Dedicated MSK cluster for that BU"

  # Data Classification Enforcement
  data_classification:
    enabled: true

    sensitivity_levels:
      - level: "public"
        topics: "platform.shared.*"
        restrictions: "none"

      - level: "internal"
        topics: "*.*.metrics.*"
        restrictions: "internal_users_only"

      - level: "confidential"
        topics: "*.member.*", "*.provider.*"
        restrictions: "business_unit_only"

      - level: "restricted_phi"
        topics: "claims.*", "pharmacy.*"
        restrictions: "strict_access_controls + data_masking + audit_logging"
        approval: "Privacy Officer + BU owner"

# Consumer Group Scoping
consumer_group_scoping:
  enforcement: "strict"

  naming_convention:
    pattern: "^{business-unit}-{application}-{consumer-name}$"

    examples:
      - "claims-adjudication-decision-processor"
      - "enrollment-member-profile-consumer"
      - "pharmacy-prescription-order-handler"
      - "provider-network-contract-tracker"

    validation:
      regex: "^[a-z]+-[a-z-]+-[a-z-]+$"
      max_length: 255  # Kafka consumer group limit

      prohibited_patterns:
        - "test-*"  # Must include BU prefix
        - "*-prod-*"  # Don't embed environment

  access_rules:
    # Rule 1: BU-scoped access
    - business_unit: "claims"
      allowed_groups: "claims-*"
      denied_groups: "enrollment-*", "pharmacy-*", "provider-*", "analytics-*"

    - business_unit: "enrollment"
      allowed_groups: "enrollment-*"
      denied_groups: "claims-*", "pharmacy-*", "provider-*", "analytics-*"

    - business_unit: "pharmacy"
      allowed_groups: "pharmacy-*"
      denied_groups: "claims-*", "enrollment-*", "provider-*", "analytics-*"

    - business_unit: "provider"
      allowed_groups: "provider-*"
      denied_groups: "claims-*", "enrollment-*", "pharmacy-*", "analytics-*"

    - business_unit: "analytics"
      allowed_groups: "analytics-*"
      # Analytics can read from all BU topics, so no denied groups

  # Rule 2: Application scoping
  application_scoping:
    enabled: true

    rules:
      # Only application X can manage consumer group X
      - application: "claims-adjudication"
        allowed_consumer_groups: ["claims-adjudication-*"]
        allowed_actions: ["VIEW", "EDIT_OFFSET", "RESET_OFFSET", "DELETE"]

      - application: "enrollment-processor"
        allowed_consumer_groups: ["enrollment-processor-*"]
        allowed_actions: ["VIEW", "EDIT_OFFSET", "RESET_OFFSET", "DELETE"]

  # Rule 3: Prevent cross-BU consumer group management
  cross_bu_protection:
    enabled: true

    prohibitions:
      - condition: "User in 'claims' BU attempts to manage 'enrollment-*' consumer group"
        action: "Deny"
        log_level: "WARNING"

      - condition: "User attempts to reset offsets for consumer group outside their BU"
        action: "Deny"
        log_level: "ERROR"
        notify: ["Security Team", "BU owner"]

# Cross-Business-Unit Access Logging
cross_bu_access_logging:
  enabled: true
  log_all_attempts: true  # Log both successful and denied

  events_to_log:
    - "Cross-BU topic read attempt"
    - "Cross-BU topic write attempt"
    - "Cross-BU consumer group access"
    - "Cross-BU schema registry access"

  log_format:
    timestamp: "ISO8601 UTC"
    user:
      email: "required"
      sso_id: "required"
      business_unit: "required"
    access_attempt:
      source_bu: "user's business unit"
      target_bu: "target resource business unit"
      resource_type: "topic | consumer_group | schema"
      resource_name: "fully qualified name"
      action: "VIEW | BROWSE | QUERY | PRODUCE | EDIT | DELETE"
      result: "allowed | denied"
      reason: "approval_on_file | analytics_exception | denied_no_approval"
    context:
      cluster: "cluster name"
      environment: "dev | test | staging | prod"

  log_retention:
    lenses_internal: "90 days"
    aws_s3_archive: "7 years"

  alerts:
    - name: "Excessive Cross-BU Denials"
      condition: "User receives >5 cross-BU access denials in 1 hour"
      severity: "MEDIUM"
      notify: ["User's Manager", "Security Team"]
      action: "Send remediation guidance email"

    - name: "Production Cross-BU Access"
      condition: "Any cross-BU access in production (even if allowed)"
      severity: "LOW"
      notify: ["Security Team"]
      reason: "Audit all production cross-BU access"

    - name: "Unauthorized Cross-BU Write Attempt"
      condition: "User attempts to PRODUCE to topic outside their BU"
      severity: "HIGH"
      notify: ["Security Team", "BU Owners", "User's Manager"]
      action: "Immediate investigation"

  reporting:
    - report: "Monthly Cross-BU Access Report"
      frequency: "monthly"
      recipients: ["Security Team", "Compliance Officer", "BU Owners"]
      contents:
        - "Total cross-BU access attempts"
        - "Cross-BU access by user"
        - "Cross-BU access by business unit"
        - "Denied access attempts"
        - "Top users with cross-BU access"

    - report: "Quarterly Isolation Compliance Report"
      frequency: "quarterly"
      recipients: ["CISO", "Compliance Committee"]
      contents:
        - "Multi-tenancy isolation effectiveness"
        - "Policy violations and remediation"
        - "Cross-BU access trends"
        - "Recommended policy improvements"

# Exception Handling
exceptions:
  analytics_bu:
    allowed: true
    justification: "Analytics BU requires read access to all topics for reporting"
    restrictions:
      - "Read-only access"
      - "Data masking enforced"
      - "No PRODUCE operations"
      - "Quarterly access review"

    approval_process:
      - step: "Analytics lead submits request"
      - step: "Source BU owner approval"
      - step: "CDO approval"
      - step: "Grant read-only access"
      - step: "Document in access registry"

  platform_bu:
    allowed: true
    justification: "Platform team requires access for operational support"
    restrictions:
      - "Platform Admin role required"
      - "All actions logged"
      - "Data masking enforced (except for troubleshooting)"
      - "Monthly access review"

    approval_process:
      - step: "Platform Admin on-call receives incident"
      - step: "Access granted for incident duration"
      - step: "Access auto-revoked when incident closed"
      - step: "Retrospective review at monthly meeting"

  temporary_cross_bu_access:
    allowed: true
    justification: "One-time access for specific integration projects"

    approval_process:
      - step: "User submits request via ServiceNow"
      - step: "Source BU owner approval"
      - step: "Target BU owner approval"
      - step: "Architecture Review Board approval"
      - step: "Grant access for max 30 days"
      - step: "Document integration and create permanent solution"

    max_duration_days: 30
    renewal_allowed: false

    criteria:
      - "Temporary integration project"
      - "No production data access"
      - "Documented plan to create proper integration"
```

#### REQ-LENS-003-007: Service Account Management

**Status**: Mandatory
**Rationale**: Secure access for applications and automation

**Requirements**:
- Create service accounts for each application/service
- Scope service accounts to specific clusters and topics
- Use API keys with expiration (maximum 1 year)
- Rotate API keys every 90 days
- Monitor service account usage and alert on anomalies
- Disable unused service accounts after 30 days

**Implementation**:
```yaml
# Service Account Configuration
# API key-based access for applications and automation

service_account_management:
  overview:
    purpose: "Provide programmatic access to Lenses.io for applications and automation"
    authentication_method: "API keys (bearer tokens)"
    storage: "AWS Secrets Manager"

  # Service Account Creation Process
  creation_process:
    workflow:
      - step: "Application owner submits service account request"
        form_fields:
          - name: "Application name"
            required: true
            example: "claims-adjudication-service"

          - name: "Business unit"
            required: true
            options: ["claims", "enrollment", "pharmacy", "provider", "analytics", "platform"]

          - name: "Environment"
            required: true
            options: ["development", "test", "staging", "production"]

          - name: "Required access"
            required: true
            description: "Describe what topics/consumer groups the service account needs"
            example: "Read access to claims.* topics, write access to claims.adjudication.* topics"

          - name: "Expiration date"
            required: true
            max_duration_days: 365
            default_duration_days: 90

          - name: "Owner email"
            required: true
            description: "Technical owner responsible for this service account"

          - name: "Backup owner email"
            required: false
            description: "Backup contact if primary owner unavailable"

      - step: "Automated validation"
        checks:
          - "Application name follows naming convention"
          - "Business unit is valid"
          - "Requested access aligns with BU topic patterns"
          - "Expiration date is within policy limits"

      - step: "Approval workflow"
        non_production:
          approver: "Team Lead"
          auto_approve: true  # Auto-approve for dev/test
          sla_hours: 4

        production:
          approvers:
            - role: "Application Owner's Manager"
              sla_hours: 8
            - role: "Platform Admin"
              sla_hours: 4
          auto_approve: false

      - step: "Service account creation"
        actions:
          - "Execute service account creation script"
          - "Generate API key with specified expiration"
          - "Store API key in AWS Secrets Manager"
          - "Grant requested permissions (role assignment)"
          - "Update service account inventory"

      - step: "Notification and delivery"
        notifications:
          - recipient: "Application owner"
            method: "Email"
            contents:
              - "Service account created: {account_name}"
              - "AWS Secrets Manager ARN: {secret_arn}"
              - "Expiration date: {expiration_date}"
              - "Instructions for retrieving API key"

          - recipient: "Security Team"
            method: "Slack"
            contents:
              - "New service account created: {account_name}"
              - "Environment: {environment}"
              - "Owner: {owner_email}"

  # Naming Convention
  naming_convention:
    pattern: "sa-{business-unit}-{application}-{environment}"

    examples:
      - "sa-claims-adjudication-prod"
      - "sa-enrollment-processor-staging"
      - "sa-pharmacy-prescriptions-dev"
      - "sa-platform-monitoring-prod"

    validation:
      regex: "^sa-[a-z]+-[a-z-]+-[a-z]+$"
      max_length: 64

      prohibited_names:
        - "sa-test-*"  # Must use proper BU name
        - "sa-admin-*"  # No admin service accounts

# API Key Generation and Rotation
api_key_management:
  generation:
    method: "lenses_api"
    format: "JWT bearer token"
    entropy_bits: 256  # Strong random generation

  expiration:
    default_duration_days: 90
    max_duration_days: 365

    expiration_policies:
      development:
        max_days: 365
        rotation_required: false

      test:
        max_days: 365
        rotation_required: false

      staging:
        max_days: 180
        rotation_required: true
        rotation_warning_days: 30

      production:
        max_days: 90
        rotation_required: true
        rotation_warning_days: 30
        mandatory_rotation: true

  rotation:
    automation:
      enabled: true
      method: "scheduled_lambda"
      schedule: "Weekly check for keys expiring in 30 days"

    rotation_process:
      - step: "30 days before expiration: Send first warning email"
        recipients: ["Owner", "Backup owner"]

      - step: "14 days before expiration: Send second warning email"
        recipients: ["Owner", "Backup owner", "Manager"]

      - step: "7 days before expiration: Send critical warning"
        recipients: ["Owner", "Backup owner", "Manager"]
        escalation: "Create ServiceNow ticket"

      - step: "Expiration date: Disable API key"
        action: "Revoke API key in Lenses.io"
        notification: ["Owner", "Manager", "Platform Admin"]

        grace_period:
          enabled: true
          duration_days: 3
          reason: "Allow emergency renewal without service disruption"

      - step: "3 days after expiration: Delete API key"
        action: "Permanently delete API key and service account"
        notification: ["Owner", "Manager", "Security Team"]

    self_service_rotation:
      enabled: true
      method: "lenses_ui_or_api"

      process:
        - "Owner initiates rotation via Lenses.io UI or API"
        - "System generates new API key"
        - "Old API key remains valid for overlap period"
        - "Owner updates application with new API key"
        - "Owner confirms rotation complete"
        - "Old API key revoked"

      overlap_period:
        duration_hours: 24
        reason: "Allow graceful cutover without downtime"

  storage:
    primary_location: "aws_secrets_manager"

    secret_naming:
      pattern: "lenses/{environment}/{business-unit}/{application}/api-key"

      examples:
        - "lenses/prod/claims/adjudication/api-key"
        - "lenses/staging/enrollment/processor/api-key"

    secret_structure:
      api_key: "<token_value>"
      created_at: "ISO8601 timestamp"
      expires_at: "ISO8601 timestamp"
      service_account_name: "sa-{bu}-{app}-{env}"
      owner_email: "owner@company.com"
      lenses_url: "https://lenses.company.com"

    access_control:
      # IAM policy for application to read secret
      iam_policy:
        effect: "Allow"
        actions:
          - "secretsmanager:GetSecretValue"
          - "secretsmanager:DescribeSecret"
        resource: "arn:aws:secretsmanager:us-east-1:123456789012:secret:lenses/{environment}/{business-unit}/{application}/*"
        conditions:
          - key: "aws:PrincipalAccount"
            value: "123456789012"  # Company AWS account

    rotation_configuration:
      automatic_rotation: true
      rotation_lambda: "lenses-api-key-rotator"
      rotation_schedule: "rate(90 days)"  # Rotate every 90 days

# Usage Monitoring
usage_monitoring:
  metrics:
    - metric: "api_calls_per_service_account"
      granularity: "1 minute"
      retention: "90 days"

    - metric: "api_call_errors_per_service_account"
      granularity: "1 minute"
      retention: "90 days"

    - metric: "data_throughput_per_service_account"
      unit: "bytes"
      granularity: "5 minutes"
      retention: "30 days"

    - metric: "last_used_timestamp"
      purpose: "Identify inactive service accounts"
      update_frequency: "real-time"

  alerts:
    - name: "Inactive Service Account"
      condition: "No API calls for 30 days"
      severity: "LOW"
      action: "Email owner to confirm still needed"

    - name: "Excessive API Calls"
      condition: "Service account exceeds 1000 calls/minute"
      severity: "MEDIUM"
      notify: ["Owner", "Platform Admin"]
      action: "Investigate potential runaway process"

    - name: "API Key Expiring Soon"
      condition: "API key expires within 7 days"
      severity: "HIGH"
      notify: ["Owner", "Backup Owner", "Manager"]
      frequency: "daily"

    - name: "Unauthorized Access Attempt"
      condition: "Service account attempts unauthorized action"
      severity: "HIGH"
      notify: ["Security Team", "Owner"]
      action: "Log incident, review permissions"

    - name: "Production Service Account in Non-Prod"
      condition: "Production service account used in dev/test environment"
      severity: "CRITICAL"
      notify: ["Security Team", "CISO", "Owner"]
      action: "Immediate investigation - potential credential leak"

  dashboards:
    - name: "Service Account Overview"
      widgets:
        - "Total service accounts by environment"
        - "Service accounts expiring in next 30 days"
        - "Inactive service accounts (>30 days)"
        - "Top service accounts by API call volume"

    - name: "Service Account Health"
      widgets:
        - "API call success rate"
        - "API call error breakdown"
        - "Service accounts with recent errors"
        - "Service account authentication failures"

# Expiration Handling
expiration_handling:
  warning_schedule:
    - days_before: 30
      recipients: ["Owner"]
      subject: "Lenses.io Service Account Expiring in 30 Days"

    - days_before: 14
      recipients: ["Owner", "Backup Owner"]
      subject: "Lenses.io Service Account Expiring in 14 Days"

    - days_before: 7
      recipients: ["Owner", "Backup Owner", "Manager"]
      subject: "URGENT: Lenses.io Service Account Expiring in 7 Days"
      escalation: "Create ServiceNow ticket"

    - days_before: 1
      recipients: ["Owner", "Backup Owner", "Manager", "Platform Admin"]
      subject: "CRITICAL: Lenses.io Service Account Expires Tomorrow"
      escalation: "Page on-call engineer"

  expiration_actions:
    on_expiration:
      - action: "Revoke API key in Lenses.io"
        immediate: true
      - action: "Update service account status to 'expired'"
      - action: "Send notification to owner"
      - action: "Create incident ticket"

    grace_period:
      enabled: true
      duration_days: 3

      grace_period_actions:
        - "API key disabled but not deleted"
        - "Owner can renew via self-service"
        - "Daily reminder emails sent"

    post_grace_period:
      - action: "Delete API key from Lenses.io"
      - action: "Delete secret from AWS Secrets Manager"
      - action: "Remove service account from inventory"
      - action: "Archive service account metadata for audit"

  renewal_process:
    self_service:
      enabled: true

      steps:
        - "Owner logs into Lenses.io"
        - "Navigate to Service Accounts > Manage"
        - "Select service account to renew"
        - "Request renewal with new expiration date"
        - "Automated approval for non-prod (instant)"
        - "Manager approval required for prod (SLA: 4 hours)"
        - "New expiration date set, notifications sent"

    max_renewals: 4  # Can renew max 4 times (max 360 days for 90-day keys)

    long_term_service_accounts:
      allowed: true
      criteria:
        - "Production applications only"
        - "Critical business services"
        - "Documented ownership and monitoring"

      approval:
        - "Application owner's Director"
        - "Platform Engineering Lead"
        - "Quarterly review required"

# Service Account Inventory
inventory_management:
  tracking:
    database: "DynamoDB"
    table_name: "lenses-service-accounts"

    tracked_attributes:
      - "service_account_name"
      - "business_unit"
      - "application_name"
      - "environment"
      - "owner_email"
      - "backup_owner_email"
      - "created_at"
      - "created_by"
      - "expires_at"
      - "last_rotated_at"
      - "last_used_at"
      - "api_key_id"
      - "secrets_manager_arn"
      - "assigned_role"
      - "status" (active | expired | revoked)
      - "approval_ticket"

  reporting:
    - report: "Weekly Service Account Expiration Report"
      schedule: "Every Monday 9 AM"
      recipients: ["Platform Admin", "Service Account Owners"]
      contents:
        - "Service accounts expiring in next 30 days"
        - "Expired service accounts in grace period"
        - "Service accounts deleted last week"

    - report: "Monthly Service Account Usage Report"
      schedule: "1st of each month"
      recipients: ["Platform Admin", "BU Leads"]
      contents:
        - "Total service accounts by BU"
        - "Inactive service accounts (>30 days no usage)"
        - "Top service accounts by API call volume"
        - "Service account creation/deletion trends"

    - report: "Quarterly Service Account Audit"
      schedule: "Quarterly"
      recipients: ["Security Team", "Compliance Officer"]
      contents:
        - "All active service accounts"
        - "Verification of ownership"
        - "Compliance with rotation policies"
        - "Recommendations for cleanup"

# Role Assignment for Service Accounts
role_assignment:
  default_role: "Developer"  # Service accounts start with Developer role

  role_options:
    - role: "Developer"
      suitable_for: "Non-production applications"
      environments: ["development", "test", "staging"]
      auto_approve: true

    - role: "Production-Developer"
      suitable_for: "Production applications (read-only)"
      environments: ["production"]

    - role: "Data-Steward"

      environments: ["all"]

      environments: ["production"]

      - "Document specific use case and justification"
      - "Security review of requested permissions"
      - "Create custom role in Lenses.io"
      - "Assign custom role to service account"
      - "Quarterly review of custom permissions"
```
